name: Display total StopLoss and TakeProfit value
summary: This is a chart utility indicator that calculates and displays the total monetary value of all open positions' StopLoss and TakeProfit levels on the chart. It updates in real-time on every tick, showing the aggregated SL and TP exposure in account currency.
summary_zh: 这是一个图表工具指标，用于计算并显示所有持仓的止损和止盈的总金额值。它在每个tick上实时更新，以账户货币显示聚合的SL和TP敞口。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个信息显示工具。它的核心功能是遍历所有当前持仓，计算每个持仓的止损和止盈金额，然后汇总显示在图表上。计算逻辑涉及将价格差值转换为货币价值，考虑了不同品种的点值、手数和交换费用。入场条件和出场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理方面，它仅读取已有仓位信息，不修改或开仓。资金管理方面，它提供了SL/TP总敞口的可视化，帮助交易者评估整体风险，但本身不进行任何资金管理操作。该工具通过对比前后tick的数值变化来优化显示更新频率，避免不必要的重绘。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but an information display utility. Its core function iterates through all current positions, calculates the monetary value of each position's StopLoss and TakeProfit, and aggregates the total for display on the chart. The calculation logic converts price differences to monetary values, accounting for different symbols' tick values, lot size, and swap fees. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trading operations. Regarding position management, it only reads existing position information without modifying or opening positions. For money management, it provides visualization of total SL/TP exposure to help traders assess overall risk, but does not perform any money management operations itself. The utility optimizes display update frequency by comparing values between ticks to avoid unnecessary redraws.

parameters.name: CORNER_LEFT_LOWER
parameters.description: 标签显示在图表左下角
parameters.description_en: Label displayed at chart lower-left corner

pros: 提供实时SL/TP总金额显示，帮助交易者快速评估整体风险敞口
计算逻辑考虑了品种的点值差异、手数和交换费用，较为全面
通过前后tick数值对比优化更新频率，减少不必要的图表重绘
作为指标运行在图表窗口，不影响交易操作，使用安全
代码结构简洁，功能单一明确，易于理解和维护
pros_en: Provides real-time total SL/TP monetary value display, helping traders quickly assess overall risk exposure
Calculation logic accounts for symbol tick value differences, lot sizes, and swap fees comprehensively
Optimizes update frequency by comparing values between ticks, reducing unnecessary chart redraws
Runs as an indicator on the chart window without affecting trading operations, safe to use
Clean code structure with single clear purpose, easy to understand and maintain
cons: GetMultiplier函数使用硬编码的digits值映射，无法适应非标准点差品种如JPY对或特殊品种
GetPips2Dbl和GetMultiplier两个函数存在功能重叠，计算逻辑冗余且容易产生精度误差
不区分账户品种，所有持仓的SL/TP值直接相加，未考虑多币种账户的汇率转换问题
止损值计算中swap费用的处理方式（直接从SL金额中扣除）在逻辑上不够严谨
缺乏错误处理机制，当SymbolInfoDouble等函数返回异常值时可能导致计算错误
cons_en: GetMultiplier uses hardcoded digits-to-multiplier mapping, unable to handle non-standard symbols like JPY pairs or special instruments
GetPips2Dbl and GetMultiplier functions have overlapping functionality with redundant calculation logic prone to precision errors
Does not distinguish account currencies, directly summing SL/TP values of all positions without considering multi-currency exchange rate conversion
The swap fee handling in SL calculation (directly deducting from SL amount) is logically inconsistent
Lacks error handling; when SymbolInfoDouble or similar functions return abnormal values, calculations may produce incorrect results
improvements: 使用SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE和SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE直接计算点值，替代硬编码的GetMultiplier函数，提高品种兼容性
增加多币种支持，通过账户货币转换确保跨币种持仓的SL/TP总值计算准确
添加错误处理和边界检查，包括SymbolInfoDouble返回值验证、零除保护和PositionSelectByTicket失败处理
improvements_en: Use SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE and SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE directly for pip value calculation instead of hardcoded GetMultiplier function, improving symbol compatibility
Add multi-currency support with account currency conversion to ensure accurate total SL/TP calculation across different currency positions
Add error handling and boundary checks including SymbolInfoDouble return value validation, zero-division protection, and PositionSelectByTicket failure handling

risk_points: 该工具仅读取和显示信息，不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
计算错误可能导致显示的SL/TP值不准确，影响交易者的风险判断决策
risk_points_en: This tool only reads and displays information without executing any trading operations, posing no financial risk
Calculation errors may cause inaccurate displayed SL/TP values, potentially affecting trader risk judgment decisions

summary_en: This is a chart utility indicator that calculates and displays the total monetary value of all open positions' StopLoss and TakeProfit levels on the chart. It updates in real-time on every tick, showing the aggregated SL and TP exposure in account currency.
